risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified detail on acquisitions, debt, liquidity, leases, and purchase commitments, supporting relatively transparent disclosure. Risk language is largely standard forward-looking-statement boilerplate, with material exposure to fuel prices, labor availability, insurance claims, regulation, customer failures, and capital requirements. Management presents liquidity and financial position positively, but several future outcomes remain qualified and uncertain.
